audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with its own explanations: win[4] and win[5] said 'Skill' while whys[4]/whys[5] argue Garen owns level 6 and first item.
audit.why: Demacian Justice (120/100/80s) is true damage on a Jayce with no defensive stats, and Stridebreaker/Black Cleaver plus Courage closes the gap he cannot kite.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 Jayce, level 4 onward Garen, two items back to Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text claimed Garen's R cooldown refreshes on a takedown.
audit.why: Riot's Demacian Justice text is an execute attempt only — no takedown reset exists in the kit data.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the verifiable spike: Demacian Justice's true damage ignores armour, so his level 6 is the real swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] said Decisive Strike slows you; and the auto-attack reset on Decisive Strike was never stated.
audit.why: Riot: Decisive Strike grants Garen move speed and BREAKS all slows on him; its next attack silences. It is also an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: Q breaks your Shock Blast slow, speeds him in, resets his auto, and silences your stance-swap.

audit.why: Courage 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and Decisive Strike's flat 8s are what the whole lane is timed against.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommended early anti-heal against Garen.
audit.why: Perseverance is out-of-combat health regen, not combat sustain; poke and chip deny it. Garen also deals true damage with R, so stacked resists do not answer his kill pattern.
audit.corrected: Drop the anti-heal line for Eclipse into Serylda's and Steelcaps.

edits.before: He out-scales your squishy 2-item frame: Courage cuts your combo, his Q silence cancels your stance-swap, and his R cooldown refreshes if he gets a takedown.
edits.after: He out-scales your squishy 2-item frame: Courage cuts your combo, his Q silence cancels your stance-swap, and Demacian Justice's true damage ignores armour.

edits.before: Land Q (Decisive Strike) to silence your stance-swap mid-combo and slow you for the empowered hit
edits.after: Land Q (Decisive Strike) to silence your stance-swap — it breaks your Q slow and resets his auto

edits.before: Poke him out — cannon-Q his step-ups, E-knock his spin. Jayce wins the Courage cooldown windows.
edits.after: Poke him out pre-4 — gate-Q his step-ups, E-knock his spin. Levels 4+ and his 120s R belong to Garen.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Form-swapping is your ult, but Demacian Justice is a 120s true-damage execute on your no-resist frame — never sit below half.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Courage's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker plus Courage closes the gap — fight only while his 17s W is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Garen carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Knife-edge at two items: he stat-checks your glass frame, but poking first and kiting on Capacitor speed still wins.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Courage (W): 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s — damage reduction plus tenacity; trade only while it is down. - Decisive Strike (Q): a flat 8s, silences your stance-swap. - Demacian Justice: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — build your teamfight around that. Garen carry threat: 6/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Form-swapping IS the ult — build your teamfight around that. Garen carry threat: 6/10 — hold Thundering Blow for his engage and play picks if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Garen wastes Courage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Thundering Blow knocks him clear of Judgment's spin range.

edits.before: Hammer-brawling when cannon was winning — fight at the range HE hates, not the one that feels brave.
edits.after: Decisive Strike is an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to swap and step back.

edits.before: Yours from level 1. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours to level 3, his from 4 once Courage and his R come online.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse  (poke + dive burst), then Serylda's Grudge; boots Plated Steelcaps. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse (poke + dive burst), then Serylda's Grudge; boots Plated Steelcaps. Skip anti-heal — Perseverance is out-of-combat regen you deny by poking, not by items.

notes: Packet winRate for jayce vs garen is 50.26 but MC_WR_TABLES.jayce.garen is 47.55 — the two sources disagree; MC_WR_TABLES is not writable so this is reported, not changed. Garen R takedown-reset claim removed as unverifiable/false.
